summary: Do not build generation on reusing original template pages as skeletons (copying a source page's body shapes and layout and swapping only text and data). Deck IR, Design Packs (source-native routes, server-owned source frames) and fixed-slot filling took this route and failed repeatedly; do not attempt it again.
invariants: Every generation path (svg, authored, template-redesign) composes page bodies itself; a registered template supplies frames, furniture, fonts, colours, composition guidance and references, not page bodies to fill.
authored.generation.original-level-visual-acceptance keeps its goal (output close to the supplied template's level); this decision rules out source-skeleton reuse as the means to reach it.
Proposals to raise template fidelity must say how they differ from source-skeleton reuse before implementation.
forbidden: Cloning a source or template page's body shapes and layout and replacing only its text, table values or chart data
Replacing free authoring with a fixed-slot IR or a Deck IR slot schema
Reintroducing Design Pack source frames, source-native routes or an equivalent under another name
